big: A futures contract worth ₹10 lakh needs only about ₹1 lakh as a deposit. That is leverage. A 2% move in the market can change the deposit by 20%, in either direction.

lines: Only ₹1 lakh for a ₹10 lakh position? That sounds cheap.

It is a deposit, called margin, not the price. It protects the exchange against default. Leverage magnifies gains and losses. Gains and losses are settled every day. If losses eat the deposit, a margin call asks for more money.
